Subject: Quick ask — extra pilot credits while we finish integration

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team here at Fieldaxe is excited to move to a two-week pilot. We started wiring up the SDK this morning and already see a few spike scenarios that will make our initial quota evaporate faster than we expected.

Short version: would Redwood be able to provision a modest top-up (we're thinking an extra $5k of promo credit or equivalent token allocation) to make sure the pilot runs through our scheduled usability tests next week?

We're happy to share a short usage sample and a timeline of experiments; we'll also be prepared to convert to a paid seat if performance and cost metrics look good. The program is important to us but we need a little buffer to finish our feature flags and run the synthetic load.

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to jump on a 15-min call.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Product
Fieldaxe Labs

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the context and for sending the usage snapshot. This is definitely the kind of ask we can support for pilots, but I need to run a quick internal approval (and check the planned gating conditions) before confirming the uplift.

Can you confirm the target dates for:
- the synthetic load test (start/end)
- the conversion criteria you plan to use (e.g., API latency <100ms 95pct, or monthly active seats >= 3)

If you can share that by end of day today I will push this through approvals. If helpful, I can provision a small emergency buffer immediately and then formalize the credit in writing after we sign off.

Schedule: I have 15 mins at 3pm PT today if you want to sync quickly.

Cheers,

Eve / Monica —

Saw Samantha's note. We typically authorize pilot top-ups up to $3k without finance sign-off if it's cleared by the Startup Programs team and the account has an active onboarding plan. Above that I need finance (Monica) to OK.

A couple of questions before we commit:
- Is Fieldaxe using streaming responses for inference or batch embeddings? (affects cost model)
- Do they have any special compliance requirements or are they using the hosted API only?

If we can get the target dates and conversion criteria from Eve's ask, I'd be comfortable approving an interim $2k buffer right away to keep the pilot moving while we formalize a $5k promo credit contingent on conversion milestones.

Ben
Enterprise Growth — Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@fieldaxelabs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — extra pilot credits while we finish integration

Hi Eve / Ben —

Thanks for the quick replies. Answers below:
- Synthetic load window: 2026-09-09 09:00 PT through 2026-09-09 18:00 PT (single-day intense run), then a follow-up run 2026-09-12 09:00 PT through 2026-09-12 12:00 PT.
- Conversion criteria: 1) MAU for pilot users >= 3 by end of pilot week AND 2) average token cost per active user under $0.10 for two successive days. We can accept a short trial extension if needed to hit those numbers.
- Tech: primarily streaming responses for the chat flows; embeddings used for similarity ranking in the background.
- Compliance: hosted API only; no special regs.

If you can provision an interim buffer that would keep our CI runs from failing while we tune batching. We can sign a short mutual action plan doc after the runs — I attached the CSV that shows current consumption.

Appreciate it,
Samantha

2) Contingent full allocation: additional $3k promo credit to be released after Fieldaxe completes the two synthetic runs and confirms conversion metrics (Eve to sign off).

Please confirm the HubSpot deal notes and add the mutual action plan link so I can attach to the finance authorization. Also attach the draft pilot terms (legal needs a short SOW).

I'll prepare a one-off promo code and routing in the billing system.
